pixel_note: FNaF 4's title is red on red: in the NEW GAME, CONTINUE and OPTIONS bands of two measured title frames (explore f4-opts 0025, f4-title 0008) the lit pixels read R 54-132 with G and B exactly 0, and no pixel passes the white-text threshold (min channel > 150) the FNaF 1-3 models use. `pixel` makes a lit pixel red >= 50 with green and blue <= 20 for the item bands and the menu gate; the title and foreign gates carry their own. `bright_min` is required by the schema and unused here.
measurement_note: Item bands are 520x52 around NEW GAME (text spans native x 944-1470, y 510-560) and CONTINUE (x 950-1510 with the night digit, y 620-670; the control map's CONTINUE press is (1230,645)). Over the 91 title frames with the menu up: newGame 0.2627 (p05) to 0.3936, continue 0.2432 (p05) to 0.3506; a band 135 px under CONTINUE reads 0.0000 on every title frame. present_min 0.12 stands a factor of two below the p05 of either row; absent_max 0.03 over the zero control.

title_gate.note: the red sky and the house skyline. 0.7373-0.7559 on all 91 title frames; 0.0000-0.0029 on the 13 Options frames, 0.0000-0.0117 on the 5 sound-cue warning frames, at most 0.2393 on in-night frames. Other games: at most 0.5000 over 1795 FNaF 2 non-title frames (two red-stripe glitch frames, 0.4688 and 0.5000, which fall in the undecided band) and 0.0107 over every FNaF 1 and FNaF 3 frame. A frame washed fully red (a jumpscare or death flash) reads 1.0000 here, and the foreign gate refuses it.

foreign_gate.note: the black tree silhouette at the lower left, which the title never lights: 0.0000 on all 91 title frames. Here the gate refuses whole-screen red washes rather than another game's title -- the two fully red FNaF 4 frames retained (after-night flashes) read sky 1.0000 and this box 1.0000, and title-observe reports them `foreign-title`, which reads as 'not this title'.

menu_gate.note: the OPTIONS row. 0.3193 (p05) to 0.4209 with the menu up; 0.0000 on the one retained title frame whose menu had not yet drawn (fnaf4-loop-n3a-teach 0001). The Options screen's EXIT (0.0996-0.1592) and the sound-cue warning's EXIT (0.0820-0.1436) sit in the same place, which is why this gate is read only after the sky gate says the title is up.

not_measured: The New Game confirmation dialog has never been captured on FNaF 4. Until it is, this model must not gate a NEW GAME tap; it identifies the title and gates CONTINUE only.
